description: Get the transcript of a YouTube video. Accepts a video URL (watch, youtu.be, shorts, embed) or an 11-character video ID. Returns the video's spoken language by default. Videos without captions are transcribed with AI speech-to-text. Use format=timestamped when you need to cite or jump to specific moments. Set include_video_info=true to also get the title, channel, publish date, duration and view count at no extra cost.

format.description: 'text' (default): one block of plain text. 'timestamped': one line per segment with [m:ss] times.

include_video_info.description: Also return the video's title, channel, publish date, duration and view count above the transcript. Free.

lang.description: Preferred language code, e.g. 'en' or 'es'. Omit to get the video's original language. A video with no captions in that language is transcribed with AI in the language actually spoken (see lang in the result).

max_characters.description: Truncate the transcript to about this many characters. Useful for very long videos.

max_units.description: The most this request may cost, in units. A video without captions needs AI transcription, which costs 1 unit per minute of audio (at least 5); if that would exceed max_units, nothing is transcribed or charged and the error gives the estimate. 1 means captions only.

video.description: YouTube video URL or 11-character video ID

name: get_transcript
title: Get YouTube transcript
